text.full:
This place is a must eat at! My friend orders the Mac and cheese which was on the happy hour and I ordered the sourdough vodka pasta. And boy oh boy was it fantastic! 

The service was quick and easy. The place was packed for lunch. When I'm ever back in town I will be sure to stop by
We went in with a very large party and they were very accommodating when we needed separate checks.  Also, the food is always great!

Got a bacon burger and side salad to go. They didn't include any utensils in the bag. The burger itself was actually good, but the simple salad was more than sad--over 50% of the lettuce was brown and super bitter. If I'm paying $25 for a burger and side combo, I at least expect a fresh, decent meal.
Kala was the best server! So helpful when I was indecisive about what to get and the food was so good. Even gave great recs for bars to hit up afterwards!

Best Pasta / Food in the area , This Place is Booming, my son is an accomplished Chef and this is where we usually end up when I come to the west side , they have a great menu Service and Bar also sell their dried Pasta to go 
    EXCELENT I highly recommend to all of my friends.
       Phil D
  Mattawa Wa

Honestly, I was surprised by how highly rated this restaurant is. I definitely don't think it lives up to the hype. The ambiance was nice, and I loved the concept of sourdough pasta, BUT both the spicy rigatoni and lemon chicken pasta were completely soaked in oil and lacked flavor. The burger was NOT IT, but the steak was decent. Overall, it was a pretty disappointing experience, especially if you're coming from California and are used to good food.

The food is awesome, atmosphere is vibrant, wish our waitress is more attentive, we had two to go boxes, but had to request a bad to carry them. And she took my payment without checking to see whether I need a copy...

THE BEST. Was only in town for less than 48 hours and tried this for the first meal and was so good we came back the next night. The pasta is unbelievable, their bread is so fresh, and their scratch drinks are very affordable! I ordered the Scratch Manhattan both nights, and they poured it at the table. Great, friendly service. I almost want to come back to Seattle just for this restaurant alone (I live in IL)
This is a brilliant place with great food and I loved it, would come back for more food.

Visiting from California. The ambiance was romantic and relaxing. The bass avocado & billionaires bacon burger was so juicy and delicious. The pork confit fries were soooo good and generous with the toppings. You must try these when you visit. Our server was quick and polite. I wish we had time to make a second trip before heading back home

text.full: One of best food bar's in Seattle. Great service and the spinning wheel for a different drink is so unique and encourages you to try a different drink for a deal. Always a fun and busy environment right next to the water. Go many times a year and its always a great experience. Wings, Burrata, and their pasta is our go-to for food.

We were in the area of Pike's, and I remembered a friend's recommendation for Von's. It was a short walk, so we headed that way. Thankfully it was early dinner time, so our hour wait allowed us a little more time to walk in the area. You can and should make a reservation. 

Our waiter was great, as was the staff checking us in. Our entire experience was very pleasant and we will certainly go again the next time we are visiting. We felt we entered an old pub with a modern vibe. It was very comfortable and the seating is such that you can still hear those around you, even in a louder environment. I love that!

We had a wild mushroom pizza, beer battered tacos and a great pasta dish. The portion sizes are generous, especially the pizza. The balance of everything they offer on the menu will make it easy for everyone to find something they like.

As a first timer to Von's I had a fantastic experience. We felt welcomed the moment we entered and as we walked past other staff members on our way to our table. Our server was Kala and she was amazing! She was very friendly, attentive and knowledgeable about the menu and made great suggestions for appetizers and entrees. We had Bang Bang Chicken, Calamari, Bacon Burger, Bolognese & lemon garlic chicken.  All were great! I would definitely recommend and if you can, ask to sit in Kala's section, she was a lot of fun!

The sauce on the tellicherry chicken and smoked guoda pasta was heavenly. I loved dipping the noodles in the sauce it was soo good and will go down as one of my favorite pastas ever. Their pizza was good as well with interesting yet very good combinations of toppings. Their pizza dough/crust was a little hard but also crispy I think if you're into that you would like it but I preferred their pasta! Their chicken was very tender as well, both dishes with the chicken were extremely good and the portions are very filling! Although I wouldn't say that it's more than one serving size. Overall I loved their food, they homemake their pasta with a sourdough starter! The service was extremely attentive, and the environment and lighting was perfect! Their pasta dishes averaged ~$27-29 and with tip and everything my total came up to ~$40.

text.full: The calamari, pizza, and burger were all excellent. Fun and unique atmosphere. Comprehensive drink selection. Highly recommend

What an amazing, cozy place! The sourdough pizza was incredible and the vibe was spot on. The staff is so friendly and attentive and our server Kala was a gem! Highly recommend the Spiced Fig, Prosciutto And Arugula pizza, chef's kiss. Will make this spot a staple in our visits going forward.

text.full:
I got the spicy rigs pasta. At a high level, it was good, but nothing special, and not something I'd gravitate towards for $27.

They advertise the pasta as "sourdough pasta". I'm not sure what that's supposed to taste like, but it didn't taste anything different from regular pasta to me. If it had a unique, fun flavor, that may motivate me to spend a bit more on it.

The noodles has a nice texture. The lemon ricotta added a nice acidic kick that I liked. The sauce was on the bland side though, which I found to be disappointing.

This was the perfect dinner to end our first visit in Seattle The Guacho sandwich was 10/10 
And my wife's Seattle classic burger was also 10/10, service was great even tho they were busy we were served and waiter checked up on us frequently to make sure we had everything we needed 
The spot had very nice decor and it had a nice bar with nice dim lighting. 10/10

An absolutely amazing dining experience!

We had such a wonderful experience at Vons 1000 Spirits! We were staying at the Sheraton and joined the waitlist at 6:30 PM when we were number 54. We left the hotel at 8:00 PM, walked about 10 minutes to the restaurant, and were seated after waiting only another 10 minutes. Honestly, the waitlist worked out perfectly!

The ambiance was fantastic, and our waiter was amazing, attentive, friendly, and wonderful throughout the evening.

But let's talk about the FOOD! Everything was delicious, but the Tellicherry chicken was hands down the best dish at our table. It was absolutely out of this world! The flavors were incredible, and it was one of those dishes you keep thinking about even after the meal is over.

They also make their own sourdough pasta, and the sourdough ciabatta was absolutely to die for!

My friends were even surprised because they said they had never seen me eat so much! Honestly, I could have finished every last bite, but I left a little behind because, well, I felt guilty eating that much!

You can tell when a restaurant puts real thought and care into its food. Between the incredible dishes, wonderful ambiance, and outstanding service, this place exceeded our expectations.

If you're in Seattle, Vons 1000 Spirits is a MUST! Don't let the waitlist discourage you. It's absolutely worth it, and I would happily come back again!

This place was so cool inside; unfortunately, we only had drinks, but the happy hour menu looked amazing, and one of the locals told me she comes often, and it's definitely worth it! 

Came in for drinks, great deals and close to all the tourist attractions like Pike's Market. 

Definitely stop in!

Amazing Food, Great Atmosphere, and Perfect for a Special Occasion!

My boyfriend and I came here for our birthday dinner, and we had such a great experience! The ambiance was amazing, and the food was even better! We ordered the rigatoni, and it was seasoned perfectly, not too much, not too little, just right. The drinks were also really good, and I loved that they had such a wide variety of food options to choose from.

One thing I absolutely loved is that they make their pasta and pizza from scratch using sourdough! Anyone who knows me knows I'm a sucker for sourdough, so that was definitely an added bonus!

The service was good, and the staff was attentive throughout our visit. We joined the waitlist before arriving, and it moved surprisingly fast! Once we got there, we were seated almost immediately, which was a huge plus.

Overall, this is such a great spot for birthdays, date nights, or any special occasion. Between the atmosphere, delicious food, and drinks, I would definitely come back a million times! Highly recommend!

text.full: The service was amazing but unfortunately I don't remember our server's name. The sourdough pasta was really good, but the standout was the Burrata baguette with almond pesto! This appetizer was amazing and I would definitely go back just for that!
Kala was by far the best server we've ever had, made the experience 10/10!  Pasta burger and drinks were really good!

I was pleasantly surprised with this place. After hearing so many people hype up the food and having my doubts, I was surprised. The presentation of the food was nice, and it was better than I thought it would be. The staff is friendly and it's cool to see them making the noodles from scratch when you first walk in. It can get a bit loud inside as the place is small but fits a lot of people.

The service was so awesome! Kala was professional and very attentive! The bolognese was outstanding , I added shrimp and mushrooms. Must have! I tried their skinny bitch drink, was super cute! Also tried their blood orange paloma , also delish! Atmosphere was fun! Must do in Seattle!

Service was great, the food was excellent, the drinks very complementary to the menu. Let's talk French fries, these were the best that I've ever had, anywhere! The pizza, that sourdough pizza crust, fabulous. The weather was perfect so we enjoyed the outdoor patio.

text.full: Very unique place! great vibes and i absolutely loved everything i tried. Drinks were great, i had the dirty doctor and it did not disappoint! I loved our waiter he was very kind and helpful, the pesto goat cheese pasta was so so delicious, and the pizza was incredible. if you're in seattle it's worth stopping by!
The pizza was the standout at Vons with their old sourdough starter. I would go back, service was great, beer was cold, and the pizza was delicious!

Cecilia was awesome! Food and drinks were
Delicious. Pizza and chicken Alfredo were awesome!
Tight quarters, but this well oiled ship has great food and a million different options. Went w a larger group and everyone was happy w their food. The signature creamy pasta dish stole the show.
